references.text: The grass withers and the flower fades, but the word of our God stands forever.
They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. You will change them like a robe, and they will pass away. But you are the same, and your years will never end.

And: 'You, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. You will roll them up like a robe, and they will be changed. But you are the same, and your years will never end.'
